about: US Standard Occupational Classification (SOC 2018) code for each of the nine roles, used to read the US-based AI usage datasets (Microsoft Working with AI; Anthropic Economic Index). Chosen by the team from O*NET occupation titles and descriptions; sustainability manager uses the same O*NET occupation as data/interests/role-interests.json. A mapping onto a published list, not generated.
taskCodesNote: The Anthropic task file (release 2025-03-27) uses O*NET-SOC 2010 task codes. Where SOC 2018 renumbered an occupation, onetTaskCodes lists the 2010 occupation(s) used for the automation vs assistance split: Software Developers, Applications (15-1132) and Systems Software (15-1133); Business Intelligence Analysts (15-1199.08) for data analyst, the closest 2010 occupation.
